history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration ensure that, in considering any revised approach to manage the benefits of reform, regular updates be considered.
history.administration_response: The Administration provided an update on its approach to benefits management as part of the Board’s interim audit of the Executive Office of the Secretary-General, which owns the process. As originally set out in the 2019 benefits management framework, stand-alone mechanisms such as the online benefits tracker should be closed once the structural elements of reform were completed, with a final update as of December 2021. An end-of-process review has been undertaken and a draft output is being finalized, which the Administration will share with the audit team in April with a view to closing the recommendation. Any remaining management reform activities have been transferred to the departmental plans of the Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance and the Department of Operational Support respectively, and their status will be updated as part of the normal business cycle. The Secretariat’s approach to benefits management has moved to the third phase set out in the 2019 benefits management framework.
history.board_assessment: As the Administration has provided an update on the status of its approach to benefits management, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
